#90007 2 2005-08-11T19:21:07Z Ngaged
Well, you can skip levels somehow, in two ways.

The first way is called Practice mode. Go to Configure and switch practice mode to on. The bad thing, though, is that you can't submit your highscores you get on the levels you've unlocked while playing in that mode. I avoid practice mode.

There's a better way, anyway! Go to Highscores and select an episode that you've played. Click on one of the levels in that episoide and you can start playing that level! Without going through the entire episode!

There you go. I hope this helps!

Okay kids, gather 'round. It's STORY TIME!!!

Once, I was going for a highscore on 77-4. All I had to beat was Johhny. SO I tried and tried, and suddenly my mom said "You have to go to bed!" Frantic, I ignored her and kept on trying. And within a matter of minutes...I beat JF! Woo! My first 0th! It was a great day, and I slept well that night.

But little did I know...clux was hanging around that episode while I was sleeping. And when I got back home from school the next day...I saw it. It! Clux had beaten my only 0th score! So I said to myself "Curse you, clux! Well, here's another challenge.

The next day, not having beaten clux, I checked 77-4. Johnny Faneca came back for revenge, and he tied with clux! I was going a little nuts. I tried playing again, and I got a new personal best! Which meant higher score! Not necesarily. I stayed at my little number 2 spot; it wasn't high enough.

A few days later, I tried it yet again. Guess who. Trib4l came in out of nowhere and took my 2 spot, knocking me to 3. I couldn't believe it. Three of the highscore masters just HAPPENED to come down and steal my score! Who next? Blobglob? Spect?

There's your story.

#129813 2 2006-01-05T02:46:34Z Ngaged
When you downloaded N, it should've come with a Userlevels.txt. That is the place where you can put your N levels.

However, you must put them in in a certain way. Here:
$Title Of Your Map#Author (Or just your name would be fine.)#Level Type (Action, Race, Puzzle, etc.)#Level Data#
And it's VERY important that you don't forget that last # in it!

Then the final thing you have to do is to make sure N and the Userlevels.txt are in the same directory. For example, I put both N and my Userlevels.txt on my desktop!

Once you do all this, you should have your maps ready to go!
I hope I made this all clear to you!

#134708 2 2006-01-22T17:05:43Z Ngaged
Okay, some things.

1. This is in the wrong forum. This would belong in General Community.
2. Please attach a file with the level data in it, instead of just posting the level data in your post.

Now the map.

1. Beware of a NaN in your level data. Delete it, because there is a stray bounce block outside the level.
2. Don't put in things if they are unnesecary. Namely, the traps, and the normal doors covering the exit switch.
3. If you get all the switches, you can't get to the exit. Get rid of some doors for it to be possible.

But still, not bad of a map. Don't feel bad. Newer maps from people always need work. (Even mine did! Gasp!) Just keep on trying, and you'll get better at mapmaking.

Oh, and next time, you can post your created levels at NUMA. Check it out sometime!

Actually, it should be map#author#type#level data# (for Userlevels). Don't forget that final #!

When you get to the debug screen while making a level, there are two boxes. The upper one contains the level data, aka the looooong numbers. Right click and click select all, right click again and click copy. You can now do two things, maybe.
-For Userlevels, follow the thing above, putting in the numbers as the level data in your userlevels.txt. Save the file.
-If you just play on debug mode, then just paste the level data in a word document or a txt. file. This makes it handier. Save the file.

#142395 103 2006-02-11T23:19:57Z Ngaged
Gragh! I've been judging for quite a while...not done yet, but here's what I've got so far.

Papyrus Sept
Creativity- 6/10. Having a zap drone patrolling an area is a nice concept in a map.
Tileset/Object use- 9/10. Really liked the tiles, nicely designed. The bounce blocks seemed to go well with the map. Liked the drone and gold placement.
Fun- 8/10. A really fun map. Only gets a tad boring at the end when you say, Well, that was kinda easy.
Total- 23/30. Good work.

Lavender Bounce Sept
Creativity- 6/10. A homing launcher on bubbly terrain. Nice.
Tileset/Object use- 8/10. Bubbly tiles looked really nice. The bounceblock placement was unique and interesting. However, I didnt like the unreachable gold outside the playing area, and I didnt like the fact that you only needed one set of doors to reach the exit.
Fun- 7/10. It feels great to kick off those curves and dodge that rocket.
Total- 20/30. Nice one, could fix up some things.

Error Sucker
Creativity- 6/10. Slipping through oneways on a narrow course. Pretty nice.
Tileset/Object use- 4/10. The oneways were placed nicely, as was the homing launcher. But there werent really too many other objects, which made it a tad dull. Okay tileset.
Fun- 6/10. Overall, pretty fun, but many times youll miss a jump and leap stupidly into a homing launcher, which really sucks.
Total- 16/30. Nice, needs a bit of work, though.

Pursued Maniak
Creativity- 8/10. Really unique drone paths!
Tileset/Object use- 7/10. Though the tileset wasnt really the best, the objects were nice. In some cases, the launch pads were a pain. I liked how you used the normal doors to guide the zap drone to the ninja and eat him. Or whatever it does. Oneways used well.
Fun- 6/10. Those slow launch pads were a real pain, but the map just kept calling you back for more, despite the pads.
Total- 21/30. Good job on this one!

The One Man Show CaptZeroth
Creativity- 8/10. I liked all those narrow paths!
Tileset/Object use- 8/10. The paths were created with thought, it seemed like. I liked how those launch pads helped you and didnt hinder your progress.
Fun- 8/10. Just so fun! Zooming through the paths is fun.
Total- 24/30. Good job, Capt!

Bridge Crossing Wellsj
Creativity- 8/10. Two full sides, and an open middle. Goodness.
Tileset/Object use- 8/10. The tileset looked like a peanut!!!lololol!!! Um, I liked that. The opening felt strange, though. The gold was placed so neatly, its amazing. Annoying gauss turret position equals good.
Fun- 8/10. Discovering cool gold paths is quite fun to do.
Total- 24/30. Great map here!

Clockwork sherbet lemon SOLARION
Creativity- 4/10. Two symmetrical sides (nearly). Meh
Tileset/Object use- 3/10. It only slightly looks like a lemon. Not too creative of objects
Fun- 3/10. Trying to reach that exit gets really boring after a while.
Total- 10/30. Sorry, but needs some work.

Vice Principal Bigblargh
Creativity- 5/10. Square little course. Mmm.
Tileset/Object use- 5/10. The tiles looked nice. But that drone just moves to darn slow! Too easy to get past it. Didnt see a need for a launch pad in there
Fun- 5/10. A nice map for speed demos.
Total- 15/30. Ouch. Sorry, man.

Memory Dex22
Creativity- 5/10. A box with a bunch of bounce blocks in it
Tileset/Object use- 5/10. Boxes are kind of boring, sorry. The bounce blocks seemed a bit randomly placed, but not too much. You had to get every switch there, which was good in this case.
Fun- 6/10. Fun to jump around in, but there isnt that much room to do so.
Total- 16/30. Nice, but needs a bit of tuning up.

Splode theshav
Creativity- 6/10. A lone rocket on a rounded course is pretty cool.
Tileset/Object use- 7/10. Nice, circular tiles (except for one, which I think could be replaced with another curvy tile). The gold around the switches looked neat. The homing launcher was placed in a perfectly annoying spot (which is good, of course).
Fun- 8/10. A great map if youre concentrating on speedy all golders.
Total- 21/30. Good map, good job!

Knowledge SquidgY
Creativity- 8/10. Very cool concept of the drone navigating through the tiled paths like that.
Tileset/Object use- 8/10. Very nice tiles; they were intimidating yet they fit the map so perfectly. I didnt like the fact that you had to backtrack to get all the gold, though. Very nice door placement for the drone.
Fun- 7/10. A pretty fun map. Definitely not a pushover, and it gives you a sense of tenseness.
Total- 23/30. Very nice drone map!

The Epic Part XXV- Godspeed Sketch
Creativity- 9/10. A narrow course map with a deadly drone roaming about. Like Sweeps We Can be Happy Underground!
Tileset/Object use- 9/10. Very nice looking tiles, man. The gold was placed with much thought, it seemed.
Fun- 8/10. Overall a really fun map. The tight squeeze part was the only part I didnt like.
Total- 26/30. Great, great job, my friend. You could be the next sweep!

Victory Guiseppi
Creativity- 8/10. You play around on a man doing a victory dancemade of tiles. Heh heh
Tileset/Object use- 9/10. Very nice tiles that resemble a happy man. Loved the gold placement; it was so neat! The chaingun is perfectly placed for the most chaos.
Fun- 8/10. Great fun. Some people wouldnt like constantly jumping for the exit switch, though.
Total- 25/30. Another great map by Guiseppi!

Focalin Wellsj
Creativity- 7/10. An open, symmetrical map of doom!
Tileset/Object use- 7/10. Its amazing how everything is symmetrical, yet it creates different gameplay! Neat gold placing, which was good.
Fun- 7/10. Because that top part is so hard, it takes a bit of fun out of it and creates frustration and anger.
Total- 21/30. Nice one, wellsj!

One Man Show v2 CaptZeroth
*See your original. I personally didnt see any big differences, except that the beginning was a bit shorter.*

The Murder of Franz Ferdinand rocket_thwumped
Creativity- 5/10. A basic mini map thing involving a single rocket. Hmm
Tileset/Object use- 6/10. Nice little tiles; they are symmetrical. Okay gold placement, but it couldve looked a little better. And out of curiosity, why was there a lone door in the upper border of the map?
Fun- 6/10. Twas a fun map. Good for speed runs.
Total- 17/30. Kinda basic, but not that bad!

Renegade 3 Evil Bob
Creativity- 9/10. An open thwump puzzle involving the weird doors. Coolio.
Tileset/Object use- 9/10. You placed all the objects with a lot of thought. I just didnt like the two launch pads leading into the oneway column.
Fun- 8/10. Highly frustrating, but a certain something tells you that you need more of it.
Total- 26/30! Excellent map, budday!

Lone Rocket smtid
Creativity- 6/10. A circular rocket course with openings for the rocket to strike.
Tileset/Object use- 5/10. I like the tile openings for the homing launchers rocket. I didnt really like some of the gold placement, though.
Fun- 5/10. Backtracking isnt really my favorite thing to do
Total- 16/30. Fine, but needs work.

SCF Remix: In Bloom astheoceansblue/pariah
Creativity- 8/10. A wide open switch grabbing bonanza!
Tileset/Object use- 9/10. I loved the objects. They worked so well together! The gold circles looked nice. The lower tiles that made the tunnel-like thing looked a bit strange, but mostly good.
Fun- 9/10. Truly fun. I could play this for a long time, looking for really awesome paths.
Total- 26/30. A really good map here.

Gonny No Dae That!! smtid
Creativity- 8/10. A mini map that created different courses as you went along. Nice!
Tileset/Object use- 7/10. Really nice how the trap doors created new paths for the drone. However, if you got them in the wrong order, you cant get one of the switches. Good for using mostly E tiles.
Fun- 7/10. Pretty fun. Annoying when you get the wrong switches, though.
Total- 22/30. Good map!

Tight Squeeze 9_4_0_0
Creativity- 7/10. An open tight squeeze trick using map. Interesting!
Tileset/Object use- 8/10. Nice little squares. Usually I dont like floating launch pads, but you had no choice but to do so here.
Fun- 7/10. Doing the same thing on both sides is rathermeh.
Total- 22/30. Nice work there, 9.

Turtle CaptZeroth
Creativity- 8/10. An interesting little concept youve got here.
Tileset Object use- 8/10. Very nice what you did with the laser drone and the doors. If you wanted to go back, the oneways were there to stop you! Cool.
Fun- 6/10. It was kinda repetitive, I must say. It made it from being more fun.
Total- 22/30. Good, good, good!

Nooks, Crannies, etc. theninjagame
Creativity- 8/10. So many pathsso many paths for the laser drone, too.
Tileset/Object use- 8/10. Great paths made of tiles! The laser drone was placed perfectly. Nice use of doors!
Fun- 7/10. Its fun to avoid stuff, isnt it?
Total- 23/30. Good job, my man!

Questionable entries:

Tile 7- Out of Reach MasterJmd. No enemies.
Tile 28- Propulsion MasterJmd. No enemies.
One mine- SquidgY. More than one enemy.
Love the rocket Foaly. I have a feeling it's impossible.

More to come.

From Annon to Doom BOBODAHOBO

Should I? BOBODAHOBO

Quadratic Missile Gemini_Dreams

Shattered Inspiration SquidgY

The dark side freik

Down the Hatch kirby

When on the Ocean floor (Redux) 9_4_0_0
Creativity- 8/10. Like a tower climb, only its actually a bunch of round tiles.
Tileset/Object use- 8/10. Glad you changed it to launch pads instead of oneways. Cool, round tiles on the inside and outside of the map. Minimal gold, which in this case was a good thing.
Fun- 8/10. Sometimes, the rocket got on your nerves, but really not that much.
Total- 24/30. Good job, mate!

Edgeplay Sendy
Creativity- 10/10. An open area with tiles that (to me) looked like a factory of some sort!
Tileset/Object use- 9/10. The tiles were the best thing about the map. There was a variety of them, and they looked professional. Loved some of the gold placement, as well. The only gold that I didnt like was the stuff around the homing launcher; it was too much of a struggle to get.
Fun- 9/10. One of the funnest things Ive played in a while! Yay!
Total- 28/30. Straight 9s! Good job, Sendy!

Llama farmer 2: Its Off To Work We Go astheoceansblue/pariah
Creativity- 10/10. I just had to. Everything about it is creative! The name, tileseverything!
Tileset/Object use- 10/10. Magnificent tiles. I loved what you did with the oneways and bounceblocks; they looked really good. I liked the gold closest to the exit, because you had to pull off a certain jump in order to grab it.
Fun- 10/10. Extremely fun, one of the funnest maps Ive ever played!
Total- 30/30! Perfect! Possibly my favorite map of all time!

Three contests Monkey of Doom
Creativity- 9/10. I thought it was cool for you to think of a good map that could fit three contest requirements!
Tileset/Object use- 9/10. The tileset looked cool for such a small map. I thought the bounceblocks worked perfectly in here.
Fun- 8/10. Quite fun, but it got a bit annoying when I hit in the wrong spot all the time.
Total- 26/30. A great KRA mini map!

Diamond Necklaces Guiseppi
Creativity- 8/10. An open tight squeeze map made from floating squarez.
Tileset/Object placement- 9/10. Great tiles. I liked how you had to use them to help get to the switch and the exit. I thought the two gold columns didnt go with the rest of the gold patterns too well, but I understand that you wanted to make a necklace out of the gold and tiling.
Fun- 8/10. Pretty fun. Going all over was kind of tiresome, but not too much.
Total- 25/30. Well done, Gui.

No answers Evil_Bob
Creativity- 9/10. Reminds me of a laser tag arena.
Tileset/Object use- 9/10. You put the oneways to good use. I liked how you had to use the lower tiles to get to the higher switches. Also, I liked how the hardest switch to get was really worth getting.
Fun- 9/10. Kicking off corners, just jumping aroundall of thats fun in here.
27/30. Great job!

Macrocosm BOBODAHOBO
Creativity- 8/10. It looked like you had to navigate through an orb-like thing.
Tileset/Object use- 9/10. The tiles remind me of Barabajagals Pupae! Which is a good thing. I thought the gold placement was pretty clever, because you couldnt lollygag for so long when you were near the homing launcher.
Fun- 9/10. For such a small map, it was fun to navigate through.
Total- 26/30. A really cool map, Bobo.

Cannon Blast theshav
Creativity- 8/10. An open, mountain-like map. Kinda cool.
Tileset/Object use- 9/10. Some of the gold placement irked me a bit. However, I really liked how you were supposed to get the switch: hit the launch pad and quickly jump off the bounceblock. Guess what? I did a super launch pad jump! Without using a tile! Only the bounceblock! In this map, you can discover so many cool routes.
Fun- 8/10. Once you finally get the jumping right, you feel great. Before then, when youre franticly dodging the chaingun drone while soaring into the airthat was kind of boring.
Total- 25/30. Cool cool map, man.

KRAce atqamar
Creativity- 5/10. Kind of creative course for a KRA
Tileset/Object use- 4/10. In some places, it wasnt really that flowy, which is bad for a race map. Also, you can cheat the map and trick the homing launcher. Yes, its possible. The tiles were kinda plain.
Fun- 5/10. The lack of flow made this one lose fun points.
Total- 14/30. Sorry, but keep on trying!

Midsplit Revised- -- sept
Creativity- 8/10. Very creative little rocket map.
Tileset/Object use- 9/10. All of the map looked very nice and neat. I liked how you used the launch pads to get from one half to another. It was cool.
Fun- 8/10. Sometimes, the oneways got annoying and were a pain, but once you got through them it was pretty fun.
Total- 25/30. A good, final map for sept!

And the Devil is Six Adoni
Creativity- 8/10. Creative, making us land on those 2 tiles.
Tileset/Object use- 7/10. Nice use of oneways. Nice switch positions. Nice to make us land in dangerous places! But I didnt like the ninjas starting position; that irked me a bit. At least a little gold wouldnt make it so empty.
Fun- 8/10. Nice and fun. It was fun to prefect our jumping skillz.
Total-23/30. Niceness.

Follow the Yellow Brick Road Guiseppi
Creativity- 9/10. Placing gold in-between squares and making us open doors to reach itreally cool, in my opinion.
Tileset/Object use- 8/10. I liked the square tiles; they looked great. The randomness of the switches was cool, too. The gold placement bothered me a bit, but I understand that you really had no choice but to make it look like that.
Fun- 8/10. Performing jumps and stuff was fun here. But sometimes, the rocket was mean and it went through one of the square corners and it hit you while you were grabbing the gold.
Total- 25/30. Grrreat! (Bad slogan for frosted flakesbut Im using it in a good way. )

Rocket Run xdude_rox
Creativity- 6/10. Pretty cool. All I can really say
Tileset/Object use- 6/10. Overall pretty nice. I dont think you need all those bounceblocks near the upper corners. Replace em with tiling. What was strange was that you could put the trap doors to good use. If you tripped them correctly and precisely, you could be propelled to the bottom of the map and live, creating a new alternative of getting the exit switch. (Unlikely someone will do that, though.)
Fun- 7/10. Hey, not bad! The oneways only got in the way a little bit.
Total- 19/30. Good job!

Questionable Entries:

A Fair Fight? Adoni. This map has mines, which strangely count as enemies.
Dex22 Recall. Im still not sure if its possible. Theshavs demo doesnt work, so Im just confused

#151614 2 2006-03-04T20:55:29Z Ngaged

Here's my way of doing it. Jump at a medium speed on the wall until the sixth thwump rushes under you. Land on it and jump across to the first gold patch. Then take a wide leap and land on the ground, and jump again onto the bounceblock. From there, slide down fairly slowly so you don't get killed. Once you get to the switch, the exit is only a few steps away.

Hope I helped! And I hope the diagram isn't too complicated...

#151799 3 2006-03-05T05:19:15Z Ngaged
'Tis quite simple, my friend!

Make the laser drone the last thing you put in for an object.
Go to the debug page and delete the last number in your level data.
Replace it with a Z (though it could be other things, but I use Z for safety).
Reload the level, and your laser drone should stay in place.

Or...

Put locked doors all around the laser drone. This way works, as well, but i personally think it looks ugly.

Hope I helped ye.

#152147 25 2006-03-06T03:02:45Z Ngaged
Crap! Really sorry for not judging a lot! T'was the homework. Thanks to Ultima for reminding me.

DiPollo -- Adoni
Creativity-6/10. Pretty creative, not much else to say.
Tileset/Object use- 6/10. Overall, it was fine. But I didn't like the switches under the bounceblocks. And getting out of the bottom area was really evil, because of the launch pads. Good tiles, though.
Fun- 5/10. Getting out of the bottom really subtracted points. Sorry!
Total- 17/30. Okay map.

Disposable Hydron
Creativity- 9/10. Really nice KRA; it had us hurry up and be precise in our fallingskills.
Tileset/Object use- 8/10. Overall, I liked the gold with the oneways; they worked well together. But I didnt like that edited launch pad. It was too deadly for my liking. Nice homing launcher position!
Fun- 9/10. Besides that edited launch pad, I found this to be quite enjoyable.
Total- 26/30. Great one, Hydron!

One Enemy Landslide -- zugbop
Creativity- 8/10. Like ascending a mountain. With chainguns.
T/O use- 6/10. I personaly thought that the switches were placed rather strangely, slightly stuck in the tiles. All those launch pads covering the right half of the map were kinda...unnessecary, in my opinion.
Fun- 7/10. Pretty fun, I suppose.
Total- 21/30. Nice job.

Axel -- Adoni
Creativity- 5/10. Kinda creative.
T/O use- 6/10. I like dthat you had to move around the middle thing well to get around it. But i didn't like that you had to do it twice...And I know you couldn't help this, but it's not centered.
Fun- 6/10. Wasn't that fun to go around twice, as I said before.
Total- 17/30. Needs only a bit more work.

Ping -- Wellsj
Creativity- 8/10. Very creative map.
T/O use- 9/10. I loved the tiles; they reminded me of some of the maps that looked like trees and you had to get the gold from under the branches. Great use of homing launcher.
Fun- 8/10. Pure funness.
Total- 25/30. Nice mappy!

You Can Run Mortal -- Monkey O Doom
Creativity- 8/10. You don't see maps like these too often anymore, which is a shame.
T/O use- 8/10. I thought the gold placement could use some work. But the the tiles were great; there was minimal room for hiding.
Fun- 8/10. Chainguns are fun to annoy.
Total- 24/30. Good ol' map!

Unseen Time (Hard version) -- Foaly
Creativity- 7/10. A "beat the drone" type of map.
T/O use- 7/10. Nice little course, required some speed to get through in time. However, there were a few extra gold pieces lyinga round outside the boarder. And usually, people don't like "there and back" themed maps...
Fun- 7/10. Getting speed is fun here.
Total- 21/30. A nice map!

Ral -- nevermore
Creativity- 8/10. Like climbing stairs. With rockets.
T/O use- 9/10. Wow. Everything was placed so neatly. Some of the gold seemed a bit out of the way, though. The side things made from the tiles looked very cool.
Fun- 8/10. Pretty fun, but not particularly when going for all gold.
Total- 25/20. Good, fun map!

Do Not Look Down 2 -- theshav
Creativity- 6/10. An open jumper. Seen those before.
T/O use- 8/10. Overall nice. The oneways just didn't seem right, though...
Fun- 7/10. Just a tad short. Otherwise a fun one.
Total- 21/30. Gut!

Bulldozer -- Hydron
Creativity- 9/10. A rocky KRA. Coolness.
T/O use- 9/10. I liked how the tiles had a "rocky" feel to them. And the map was uncheatable, which is definately good for a KRA! The gold made for an extra challenge.
Fun- 8/10. Though a challenge, I didn't find the gold as fun to grab.
Total- 26/30. Sehr gut!

Tank troubles -- chasethebase
Creativity- 6/10. Not much too say...it's a tank.
T/O use- 7/10. The homing launcher was effective, but not a lot. It was easy to kill the rocket. I don't see what the sideways launch pad is for...
Fun- 7/10. Nice one for speed runs, I think.
Total- 20/30. Not bad!

Call me Ishmael -- CaptZeroth
Creativity- 8/10. Nice and creative.
T/O use- 8/10. Overall a nice layout. Some of the gold shouldn't have been scattered out, I thought. But that's my opinion. Clever homing launcher position!
Fun- 8/10. A fun one to bounce around and get gold in.
Total- 24/30. Nice map, Captain!

One Ways are not your friend -- Nemetacyst
Creativity- 6/10. This kind of thing has been done before, sorry.
T/O use- 6/10. You can cheat in this one, obviously. The bad thing is that it's hard not to cheat. You can jump underneath the exit accidentally and win.
Fun- 6/10. I'm not really a fan of cramped and compact maps like this, personally.
Total- 18/30. Fair job.

I'll do some more when I get some more time. Sorry again!

#155234 2 2006-03-16T15:35:20Z Ngaged
Well, where do you want them? Here are your possiblilities.

1. Play in debug mode.
a. Copy the "Map data" from the NUMA map.
b. Clear the digits that are in the upper box of debug mode.
c. Paste the map data from the NUMA map into that box.
d. Click out of the box. Failing to do so will result in a messed up map.
e. Load the level by pressing L.
f. Turn on caps lock.
g. Press P to play.

2. Put them in Userlevels.
a. Copy the "1.4 Map data" from the NUMA map.
b. Paste the data into your Userlevels.txt.
c. Save the file.
d. Make sure the Userlevels are in the same directory as N. If it isn't, move it there.
e. Open N, and go to Userlevels.
f. It should be ready to play.

There ya go. I hope this solves your problem.

Creativity- 5/10. Kind of creative course for a KRA
Tileset/Object use- 4/10. In some places, it wasnt really that flowy, which is bad for a race map. Also, you can cheat the map and trick the homing launcher. Yes, its possible. The tiles were kinda plain.
Fun- 5/10. The lack of flow made this one lose fun points.
Total- 14/30. Sorry, but keep on trying!

Midsplit Revised- -- sept
Creativity- 8/10. Very creative little rocket map.
Tileset/Object use- 9/10. All of the map looked very nice and neat. I liked how you used the launch pads to get from one half to another. It was cool.
Fun- 8/10. Sometimes, the oneways got annoying and were a pain, but once you got through them it was pretty fun.
Total- 25/30. A good, final map for sept!

And the Devil is Six Adoni
Creativity- 8/10. Creative, making us land on those 2 tiles.
Tileset/Object use- 7/10. Nice use of oneways. Nice switch positions. Nice to make us land in dangerous places! But I didnt like the ninjas starting position; that irked me a bit. At least a little gold wouldnt make it so empty.
Fun- 8/10. Nice and fun. It was fun to prefect our jumping skillz.
Total-23/30. Niceness.

Follow the Yellow Brick Road Guiseppi
Creativity- 9/10. Placing gold in-between squares and making us open doors to reach itreally cool, in my opinion.
Tileset/Object use- 8/10. I liked the square tiles; they looked great. The randomness of the switches was cool, too. The gold placement bothered me a bit, but I understand that you really had no choice but to make it look like that.
Fun- 8/10. Performing jumps and stuff was fun here. But sometimes, the rocket was mean and it went through one of the square corners and it hit you while you were grabbing the gold.
Total- 25/30. Grrreat! (Bad slogan for frosted flakesbut Im using it in a good way. biggrin.gif)

Rocket Run xdude_rox
Creativity- 6/10. Pretty cool. All I can really say
Tileset/Object use- 6/10. Overall pretty nice. I dont think you need all those bounceblocks near the upper corners. Replace em with tiling. What was strange was that you could put the trap doors to good use. If you tripped them correctly and precisely, you could be propelled to the bottom of the map and live, creating a new alternative of getting the exit switch. (Unlikely someone will do that, though.)
Fun- 7/10. Hey, not bad! The oneways only got in the way a little bit.
Total- 19/30. Good job!

Road to Ruin - Sept
Creativity- 8/10. Like the name implies, it looks like ruins! Playing around in ruins is fun.
Tileset/Object use- 8/10. Very nice ruin tiles, but perhaps there could've been more. The goldplacement was good; it looked very neat. unfortunately, the homing launcher didn't do much when you got down near the exit.
Fun- 8/10. A really fun map, especially when going for a good all gold run.
Total- 24/30. T'is cool, sept. T'is cool.

DiPollo -- Adoni
Creativity-6/10. Pretty creative, not much else to say.
Tileset/Object use- 6/10. Overall, it was fine. But I didn't like the switches under the bounceblocks. And getting out of the bottom area was really evil, because of the launch pads. Good tiles, though.
Fun- 5/10. Getting out of the bottom really subtracted points. Sorry!
Total- 17/30. Okay map.

Disposable Hydron
Creativity- 9/10. Really nice KRA; it had us hurry up and be precise in our fallingskills.
Tileset/Object use- 8/10. Overall, I liked the gold with the oneways; they worked well together. But I didnt like that edited launch pad. It was too deadly for my liking. Nice homing launcher position!
Fun- 9/10. Besides that edited launch pad, I found this to be quite enjoyable.
Total- 26/30. Great one, Hydron!

One Enemy Landslide -- zugbop
Creativity- 8/10. Like ascending a mountain. With chainguns.
T/O use- 6/10. I personaly thought that the switches were placed rather strangely, slightly stuck in the tiles. All those launch pads covering the right half of the map were kinda...unnessecary, in my opinion.
Fun- 7/10. Pretty fun, I suppose.
Total- 21/30. Nice job.

Axel -- Adoni
Creativity- 5/10. Kinda creative.
T/O use- 6/10. I like dthat you had to move around the middle thing well to get around it. But i didn't like that you had to do it twice...And I know you couldn't help this, but it's not centered.
Fun- 6/10. Wasn't that fun to go around twice, as I said before.
Total- 17/30. Needs only a bit more work.

Ping -- Wellsj
Creativity- 8/10. Very creative map.
T/O use- 9/10. I loved the tiles; they reminded me of some of the maps that looked like trees and you had to get the gold from under the branches. Great use of homing launcher.
Fun- 8/10. Pure funness.
Total- 25/30. Nice mappy!

You Can Run Mortal -- Monkey O Doom
Creativity- 8/10. You don't see maps like these too often anymore, which is a shame.
T/O use- 8/10. I thought the gold placement could use some work. But the the tiles were great; there was minimal room for hiding.
Fun- 8/10. Chainguns are fun to annoy.
Total- 24/30. Good ol' map!

Unseen Time (Hard version) -- Foaly
Creativity- 7/10. A "beat the drone" type of map.
T/O use- 7/10. Nice little course, required some speed to get through in time. However, there were a few extra gold pieces lyinga round outside the boarder. And usually, people don't like "there and back" themed maps...
Fun- 7/10. Getting speed is fun here.
Total- 21/30. A nice map!

Ral -- nevermore
Creativity- 8/10. Like climbing stairs. With rockets.
T/O use- 9/10. Wow. Everything was placed so neatly. Some of the gold seemed a bit out of the way, though. The side things made from the tiles looked very cool.
Fun- 8/10. Pretty fun, but not particularly when going for all gold.
Total- 25/20. Good, fun map!

Do Not Look Down 2 -- theshav
Creativity- 6/10. An open jumper. Seen those before.
T/O use- 8/10. Overall nice. The oneways just didn't seem right, though...
Fun- 7/10. Just a tad short. Otherwise a fun one.
Total- 21/30. Gut!

Bulldozer -- Hydron
Creativity- 9/10. A rocky KRA. Coolness.
T/O use- 9/10. I liked how the tiles had a "rocky" feel to them. And the map was uncheatable, which is definately good for a KRA! The gold made for an extra challenge.
Fun- 8/10. Though a challenge, I didn't find the gold as fun to grab.
Total- 26/30. Sehr gut!

Tank troubles -- chasethebase
Creativity- 6/10. Not much too say...it's a tank.
T/O use- 7/10. The homing launcher was effective, but not a lot. It was easy to kill the rocket. I don't see what the sideways launch pad is for...
Fun- 7/10. Nice one for speed runs, I think.
Total- 20/30. Not bad!

Call me Ishmael -- CaptZeroth
Creativity- 8/10. Nice and creative.
T/O use- 8/10. Overall a nice layout. Some of the gold shouldn't have been scattered out, I thought. But that's my opinion. Clever homing launcher position!
Fun- 8/10. A fun one to bounce around and get gold in.
Total- 24/30. Nice map, Captain!

One Ways are not your friend -- Nemetacyst
Creativity- 6/10. This kind of thing has been done before, sorry.
T/O use- 6/10. You can cheat in this one, obviously. The bad thing is that it's hard not to cheat. You can jump underneath the exit accidentally and win.
Fun- 6/10. I'm not really a fan of cramped and compact maps like this, personally.
Total- 18/30. Fair job.

Fantastic -- Guiseppi
Creativity- 7/10.
T/O use- 7/10. The thing that I didn't really like was the beginning, where the bounceblock just threw you on the ground. If the ninja was right under it, then that would've been good. I liked the gold placement; the same all around, and it was neat, as well.
Fun- 7/10.
Total- 24/30. A good submission.

Clover -- Yahoozy_Guacamole
Creativity- 6/10.
T/O use- 6/10. Just some things. Gold doesn't look very good over switches. It would look better if you took it off them. And also, that oneway over the homing launcher just seems odd in that place. If it was centered, it would probably not seem that way.
Fun- 6/10.
Total- 18/30. Not bad.

Twitching guilds (fire) -- Mysterypower
Creativity- 5/10.
T/O use- 5/10. I didn't like that the gold was the path. It looked really unprofessional that way. Also, the map pretty small, which made the map a bit short.
Fun- 5/10.
Total- 15/30. Oog. Sorry man.

Twinkle Twinkle -- Yahoozy_Guacamole
Creativity- 7/10.
T/O use- 6/10. Again, gold over switches doesn't look good. Also regarding the gold, it was kind of a pain to get all of it, because it was in the most unconvienient places. However, I liked how the map was mostly symetrical. Also, the oneways were great for the map. Just an extra thing to jump off of if needed.
Fun- 7/10.
Total- 23/30. Nice work.

Angel Wings -- Yahoozy_Guacamole
Creativity- 6/10.
T/O use- 7/10. Gold over swicthes again. And I personally found the oneways just a bit annoying. Also, the gameplay was kinda repetitive. But I liked the simplistic look of it all. That was a plus.
Fun- 6/10.
Total- 19/30. Fine map!

Round and round we go -- chasethebase
Creativity- 5/10.
T/O use- 4/10. The way the traps were placed, it was too easy to make the rocket die. And it wasn't that creative of a tileset, either...which, I must add, made it too easy and short.
Fun- 4/10.
Total- 13/30. Ouch. Needs some work.

Invisible walls -- madnick
Creativity- 3/10.
T/O use- 3/10. Ugh! There was so much gold! I didn't like that it totally erased the path. Because of this, you died frequently and therefore had to wait for a long loading time. Not good.
Fun- 2/10.
Total- 8/10. Really sorry, but it needed some fine-tuning.

Aforementioned -- 9_4_0_0
Creativity- 8/10.
T/O use- 8/10. I thought that there was maybe a little bit too much gold, or just boardering the edge of too much. Also, I didn't find those launchpads very useful in that tunnel-like thing. But the tileset was excellent, and you used the homing launcher well.
Fun- 9/10.
Total- 25/30. Great job!

Wandering Man -- Qix
Creativity- 5/10.
T/O use- 5/10. The path was hard to find at the beginning, but then I found it. You have to beware of door glitches; you can just touch the locked door and you'll win.
Fun- 5/10.
Total- 15/30. Not too bad...

Slip n' die -- thegnome54
Creativity- 6/10.
T/O use- 6/10. I didn't find the gold patterns outside the map to be useful, but they just added to the loading time. Unfortuantely, it was indeed cheatable, and in KRAs, that's not a good thing.
Fun- 7/10.
Total- 19/30. Nice...

Bubonic -- ConfusedCartman
Creativity- 8/10.
T/O use- 6/10. As seen in my uber quick demo on the map page, it can easily be cheated. I found getting the gold a little too annoying and not exactly fun. But it was a pretty nice layout.
Fun- 5/10.
Total- 19/30. Not bad at all...

just a little lonely really not dangerous chaingun drone -- starburst
Creativity- 8/10.
T/O use- 6/10. What I really didn't like was that launchpad that was facing down. Sometimes, it could kill you, and it was just so slow and it caught you nearly every time. The oneways were annoying at times, as well. Also, I didn't like that the map was so long. But many things were placed very neatly, and I just adored the tileset.
Fun- 6/10.
Total- 20/30. Nice one.

Curves - revised -- wlukach
Creativity- 8/10.
T/O use- 9/10. Very nice tileset, I must say. And the chaingun was placed very well. I just thought that there could've been just a little bit more gold.
Fun- 8/10.
Total- 25/30. Great!

Boxed In -- Gemini_Dreams
Creativity- 5/10.
T/O use- 5/10. Meh. One piece of gold per box just doesn't cut it. I found the positions of some of the oneways rather annoying, and easily cheatable. The tiled stars looked nice, but they didn't seem to go with the overall look of the map.
Fun- 4/10.
Total- 14/30. Needs some work.

Once the sun goes down -- 9_4_0_0
Creativity- 8/10.
T/O use- 8/10. Overall, I liked it. Very cool use of the glitch in this map. And nice, simplistic tiles. But I didn't really like the end; I found it just a bit annoying.
Fun- 8/10.
Total- 24/30. Good work!

War -- Starburst
Creativity- 7/10.
T/O use- 3/10. Ouch, I'm sorry. You just made it so long! You spread out those switches way too much. And those tight squeeze areas got a tad annoying after a bit.
Fun- 3/10.
Total- 13/30. Could've been better, I thought.

Laser age -- Starburst
Creativity- 8/10.
T/O use- 8/10. You created quite a tricky environment with those tiles, which I liked. I didn't see any point in having those launch pads there, though. The just killed me. Perfect position of the laser drone!
Fun- 7/10.
Total- 23/30. Really cool map.

Slanted Obstacle -- blackbeltninga671
Creativity- 7/10.
T/O use- 7/10. It was a pretty tricky map to navigate through, which I found fun. But sometimes, if you landed too hard on a tile, you would go through the tile (in a way) and hit the mine. That's what i didn't like.
Fun- 7/10.
Total- 21/30. Nice map.

CrimNal -- freedmand
Creativity- 3/10.
T/O use- 3/10. This level was way too long. And, frankly, rather boring. And cheatable. Which means you could've changed some things a bit.
Fun- 2/10.
Total- 8/30. Really sorry about this, but it needs some serious work.

Ipso Facto -- WCHEESEFACE3
Creativity- 6/10.
T/O use- 6/10. I liked the small middle section of the map with the laser drone guarding the gold inside. But the rest of the map seemed rather empty and too open.
Fun- 7/10.
Total- 19/30. Nice, I say.

Traveling Salesman -- InuyashaDuelist
Creativity- 4/10.
T/O use- 3/10. But you did say that you didn't put much time into it...otherwise, I'd say it was much too empty and that the playing area wasn't centered.
Fun- 3/10.
Total- 10/30. Some thought in the map would be nice.

Spin -- Qix
Creativity- 6/10.
T/O use- 6/10. The real way you would do the race had you repeat a path, which isn't that cool. But it was a good map for speed demos.
Fun- 6/10.
Total- 18/30. I say...a nice little map.

Arbalest -- JTROX
Creativity- 7/10.
T/O use- 7/10. EVerything was pretty nice except for the smashed-together gold. It didn't look to professional when it was like that. The middle, especially, was very nice, because the laser drone could get you when you least expected it.
Fun- 7/10.
Total- 21/30. A nice map by JT!

Gold Rush 100 -- Starburst
Creativity- 9/10.
T/O use- 6/10. The first half was way too hard for a KRA. I'm not sure if it's even possible to do without killing the rocket...not very fun. But on the other half...it looked amazing. The gold was placed extremely well, and I think you should use that exact layout for a future map.
Fun- 2/10.
Total- 17/30. Try to make it so it's more possible to beat.

Thunder Struck -- Qix
Creativity- 5/10.
T/O use- 6/10. Because the gold was so tuck in the tiling, the whole map seemed a tad empty. But otherwise, good use of the chaingun.
Fun- 7/10.
Total- 18/30. Nice work!

Asteroids -- McP3000
Creativity- 9/10.
T/O use- 9/10. An excellent tileset, and excellent placement of the gold. I just thought some "3" tiles would be better to use than normal doors, personally. Very tricky jumps made for some intense action.
Fun- 9/10.
Total- 27/30. A very good map, my friend.

Primordial Foe -- McP3000
Creativity- 8/10.
T/O use- 8/10. I like dthe tileset a lot; it was a lot like your previous submission. But that middle irked me with it's compact space because of the bounceblocks. Bounceblocks + Small area = No.
Fun- 7/10.
Total- 23/30. Some good work!

Flamin' -- Macaddict_17
Creativity- 7/10.
T/O use- 7/10. Overall, a very nice layout, especially the flamin' tileset. (Ha ha joke!) However, in that exit switch room, you really didn't need those two locked doors on the wall. You could get up there with some simple speed and a quick jump. I also found that launchpad to be a nuiscence at the end.
Fun- 7/10.
Total- 21/30. Flamin' good.

If your map has not appeared on my judging, it has most likely been not put on here because it didn't fit the requirements, or I somehow missed it. If you have any questions regarding your missing map, feel free to P.M me.

I am now done with judging. Great contest, you guys! And some great submissions!

So the city lines up in front of the fountain. The first is an old man who is blind. SO he dunks his head slowly into the water. then he pulls it back out. he opens his eyes for the first time. "I can see!" he exclaimed.

The next person is a deaf man. he dunks his head into the water. He starts hearing the birds, and the trinkling of the fountain. "I can hear!" he exclaimed.

Then comes an old guy in a wheelchair. Slowly, he drives his chair into the water. Very slowly...splash! He's in the fountain. he waits for the miracle to happen; to be able to use his legs normally. He waits. Nothing happens. So he looks down. The wheelchair gets new tires.

#8252 1 2006-04-23T03:05:23Z Ngaged
Dear friends...I'm afraid I have to leave this wondrous place.

My mom is accusing me of spending too much time on the computer, when in reality, I'm not. She knows that I have played N constantly; she thinks it's all I ever do. She thinks I'm behind on my homework. And my leaving is the only way to solve this.

I really love this place, guys. I'm really going to miss it. Thinking about leaving just put some tears into my eyes. I've learned a lot while I was here, which is slightly surprising, seeing as it's just a video game forum. I believe I've gotten more mature during my time here, which has effected the way I act outside of my computer wonderland. Because of sniping on NUMA, I learned to just get over it and keep on going with it.
NUMA leads me to another thing. I'm out of map-making juice. I can't think of anything great to make anymore. And besides, I guess the ending of a column in my episodes is a good end to my little career.

I was never planning to leave this place, until now. To please my parents, I guess I'll have to leave. Which really sucks.

But I will definately not forget about this place. I may appear somewhere around here when you least expect it. And maybe my juices will get flowing and I'll submit another map to NUMA.

Do anything to my maps that you want. Just give me credit if you do so, please. If possible, it would be great to have all my maps rated, so I could see my total average rating when I buzz by. Doesn't have to happen, but it sure would be cool.

And on a little lighter note, don't forget my birthday, which will come in summer.

Take care, you guys. I'll always remember you.

~Special thanks to:
-Keron Cyst, for the forums. Keep up the good work, man. These forums were great for getting to know the N community. Great fun. I'll miss you, buddy.
-Nick Johnson, for NUMA. NUMA has been a big part of my life. Submitting maps for everyone was just great. Don't give up, despite all these strange snipings and Multi-accountings.
-Mare and Raigan, for N. The greatest game I've ever played. Thank you guys so much for creating it. I'll try to be around for your future games.
-All of you, for being there to support me in any way. For being kind and friendly to me when I was feeling down or whenever. All you guys are my friends.

Goodbye.

Bobodahobo :: Tentacular Amenities

Clovic :: Reach for the Sky
Originality- 16. A wide and open little map, slightly common, but not really.
Quality- 40. Perhaps a bit near the empty side. The gold placement seemed a tad plain, and the two paths to the exits weren't exactly creative. But I loved how you got to the exit switch, and the little center area was fun, as well.
Total- 56.

Evil_Bob :: Flming Hoops

Total- 45.

xdude_rox :: Got Mail?
Non-existing map.

#178078 2 2006-05-20T12:48:04Z Ngaged
Welcome! To watch demos in N, you must...

1. Load a map in N's debug mode.
2. Get your demo data for that map from somewhere, like NUMA.
3. Go back to N, and clear out all of the data in the lower box.
4. Paste your demo data into that box.
5. Press 3.
6. Press Q.
7. Press P to enjoy your demo.

Hope this helps!

#187202 2 2006-06-10T13:42:35Z Ngaged
To play the map, you must...

1. Go to debug mode.
2. Press L to load your map data.
3. Press P to Play!

Pretty easy, eh? Unless I misunderstood you and you actually don't know how to load and save and stuff...might as well tell you that, too.

To save:
1. Go to debug mode.
2. Copy all of the data in the level data box (the upper box).
3. Paste it somewhere in a file, like a .txt, or a word document.
4. Save the data!

To load:
1. Copy all the level data from your file.
2. Go to debug mode.
3. Get rid of everything in the upper box.
4. Replace it with your level data.
5. Press L to load the map.

Hope I've got it covered for ye.

#187313 28 2006-06-10T18:13:52Z Ngaged
Fbf is short for "Frame by frame", which is a mode that is time-consuming, but will make sure your runs are nearly perfect when done well. We don't want this mode used in the highscores; it's cheating.
#187316 2 2006-06-10T18:17:33Z Ngaged
Don't feel stupid. Evryone's confused and puzzled at first.

1. Load your map and stuff (you know how to do that, I assume).
2. Press 2.
3. Press 1.
4. Play the map. You are now recording while you're playing this run.

To make sure you've successfully recorded, do this:
1. Go back to debug mode.
2. Press 3.
3. Press Q.
4. Press P and see if it starts playing the demo.

Hope I've covered it for ya.
#187323 3 2006-06-10T18:22:52Z Ngaged
Quote: Brttrx, June 10, 2006 12:01 pm
-Change Drone Speed
Despription: Self explainatory

-Lights
Despription: Some areas of the map could be really dark, and you could place lights at certain spots. Cool effect.

-Changeable background
Despription:This idea would be nice. People could make backgrounds that fit the cordinates the playing area of N, to give each level a little flavor. It could work very well. It would be sweet to have a black background, and colored ninja on a chain gun map.

-Powerups
Despription: We've all seen this one before, but poeple over-do it on the idea. N is a somewhat simple game, and big changes in gameplay can be bad. Power-ups could be 5 second invisibility, (make a map where you have to run trough mines to get to one place another), or something like that.
Changing speed: No. The challenge is to take what you've got and make the best out of it. Many people have succeeded with the normal drone speed.

Lights: Probably not. It's not really bad, but if the ninja wanders into a dark area, that could result in an unfair death, because you obviously can't see.

Background: Nah. N is a simplistic thing, and it doesn't need any fancy backgrounds or anything.

Powerups: No. Same reason as before. Even five seconds would be too much.

For the past few years, especially in Middle School, I kept thinking of suicide. It just seemed like a simple way for you to get rid of all your problems. But some people don't keep in mind those who will be effected by your deadly choice. Your parents, neighbors, other kids that were around you...

Fortunately, I thought of that before attempting it. So here I am today.

The people who do it aren't stupid at all. Of course, you might think "Why the heck would he/she do that? How stupid of him/her!" But they're not stupid. They're just troubled individuals who need a hand.
#214218 21 2006-08-11T01:46:11Z Ngaged
Quote: Obby, August 10, 2006 08:35 pm
I didnt say stupid. ANd Im nt saying you said I did. What I meant was that they are too involved in themselves to think of how hurt others will be. And way to go that you thought of others before suicide.

Oh, I was reffering to yahoozy's post. Guess I didn't see yours.

Yeah, self-esteem is one of the main factors for suicide, I believe. Especially in school, because that was on my mind when I was thinking about it.

They don't think of themselves as people who'd be "accepted" by others of "higher class". They don't think of themselves as real people. They might not think they look cool, act cool, or relate to anything with "cool". I didn't, either. But what I eventually understood, and what suicidal people have to understand, is that life won't always be perfect, and they have to make due with what they've got, or try to make the things they don't like about themselves better.

For example, I am trying out contacts instead of crummy glasses, and I'm finding way better clothes that are cool and I like, as well. As a result, I'm happier with myself than I was before.

'Tis a simple question.

1. Make sure your N application and Userlevels.txt are in the same directory, like your desktop.

2. When inserting levels into Userlevels, it must be put in a specific format:
$Map Name#Author#Level Type (Action, Puzzle, Race, etc.)#Level data#
Be sure not to forget that # at the end!

Hopefully I've covered this problem for you.

#10993 1 2006-08-31T20:23:23Z Ngaged
At first, I was planning on posting something big. Something marvelous. Something that had a lot of effort put into it. Instead of what I'm about to tell you.

This is the story.

===
Ngaged was feeling bored and kind of sad one day. He didn't have much inspiration to make maps. No ideas came to mind. (That explains the lack of maps on NUMA.) But Ngaged still wanted to do good things for the community and make some more maps. But he didn't know how he could do it...until...

Suddenly, Ngaged thought of an idea. Sure, it had been done before. But Ngaged was thinking of creating...a level pack.

Ngaged didn't want to do it alone. So he called some of his greatest inspirations of mapmaking. He called upon TDL (formica), Stepself, Pariah (astheoceansblue), great_sea, wellsj, and blue_tetris. Soon he got responses. TDL said he would like to participate. So did stepself. So did Pariah. So did great_sea. So did wellsj. B_T didn't want to (which I fully understand, man).

There was hope. Perhaps Ngaged and all of these brilliant people could combine forces and do something extremely awesome for the community. Because they all deserved it.

We planned to be ready by the end of summer. But then we wondered "What should our name be?" After a while, we all decided on a simple name, that fit with the situation. We called it Summer's End.

And so, everyone got straight to work. Everyone was out at work making maps.

TDL came up with some ideas for the project which everyone agreed upon. He even created a little subforum for us in his own forums so we could easily communicate. And great_sea announced that he couldn't work on maps anymore. However, to make up for it, he said he would make something a bit more interesting. And he got to work on that. Everyone else on the team was busy making their wonderful maps.

It was a great time. TDL was finished with all of his maps, Ngaged was, and stepself was nearly finished.

...

But then, when summer was drawing to a close, unfortunate things started happening. Wellsj announced that he couldn't participate anymore because he was preparing for school exams. (Which is the right decision, my friend. ) A bit later, great_sea announced that he was moving to a new home. But his new home didn't have internet. He said that he couldn't participate anymore.

With that, two members were gone. And it was almost at the end of summer, when we planned to release our level pack. Ngaged contacted the remaining members, but only got a real response and update from TDL. Summer's End wasn't going too well.

So I had no choice.

TDL had already submitted his portion to the forums as something else. And I then decided made my maps the second addition to my episodes.

Summer's End...was no more.

And that's the story. Sorry we couldn't do this for you guys.

===
For the Summer's End team:

I owe a big apology to teveryone, so I'll say it here. I'm sorry that we weren't able to do this. I thought we would, but before we could make some real progress, uncontrollable things happened to halt our progress. I don't know how or why this ended up the way it did...

Guys...Honestly tell me, please...Was I a bad leader?

The most important thing to look for in a Race map is the flow. You should make the player feel like they're going through the map smoothly. No sudden jumps that go off the path or anything like that.

Also, make sure you don't make the course repetitive. Don't have the player do the same thing over and over again. It gets annoying and boring.

#236176 3 2006-10-02T01:46:11Z Ngaged
Well, first of all, before you even think about playing a userlevel, follow these small instructions:

1. Make sure your userdata is in the correct format. The format is: $Author#Level name#Level type (Action, Puzzle, Race, etc)#Level data#
Make sure you don't forget that last #!
When you have all of your levels in this format, save it.

2. Make sure your N application and your Userlevels.txt are in the same directory, or in the same area. For example, they could both be in your N folder. Or they could both be on your dektop. Anywhere you choose, but they must be together.

Now, you may think about playing your userlevels! Just go into N, and go to Userlevels. If you followed the above instructions, your userlevels should show up.

Edit: Graghy! Twistkill!

Try to avoid going fast in this level, except when you're around a gauss turret.

#244070 3 2006-10-21T18:16:55Z Ngaged
1. How to Play 'em.

It's really easy. Just reset your map (press R) and then press P to Play it. Be sure that caps lock is on.

2. Userlevels.

This might be a bit more complicated.

In your N folder that you got when you downloaded N, you should have something called Userlevels.txt. That is the file where you can put custom-made levels in there and play them almost as if you were playing them in the real game. To put your own levels in there, you must put them in in a specific format:

$Author#Name of level#Type of Level#Level data#

Fill in those spaces, and just put that all in into your Userlevels.txt.

Hope I helped! If you need any more help, feel free to ask.

That's an interesting observation. I've kinda noticed that as well.

I have an idea as to how this has happened. Not sure if it's that accurate, but I'm just thinking. You know how we have all these levels or level packs created by some of the more well-known members of the community? A vast majority of those maps are more Action. These Action maps are then shown to potential beginners to the game who then start making millions of action maps. Thus, the numbers of Race maps decrease, because they are not aware of what a Race map consists of. This kind of effects the other playable categories of maps, like Puzzle and Survival. But going back to what was noted earlier, we've lost some of the mapmakers who specialized in Race maps, but we still have enough good Survival and Puzzle makers to keep those categories going. You can clearly see how Action is the more "dominant" category.

No idea if that made any sense to anyone, but it was worth a shot.
